verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents an official MCP server (Connect MCP) that agents/apps can add to make tool calls across 3,000+ APIs and 10,000+ tools, with automatic auth/token handling requiring no additional implementation. This is first-party documentation confirmed by a probe, though lacking independent hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: independent/community verification of the MCP server working in practice, and details on rate limits/reliability at scale.
